deleteAccount.entryHint: Permanently erase your account and all data

deleteAccount.intro: This permanently deletes your account and everything in it. It cannot be undone, and we cannot recover it for you afterwards.

deleteAccount.loadFailed: Could not load your account details. Check your connection and try again.

deleteAccount.deletedBody: Your account and data are gone. We couldn't automatically revoke everything though — please disconnect these yourself:

import.bankSubtitle: CIH, Attijariwafa, or any bank — export a CSV
import.csvBody: Processed entirely on your device. If we can't recognise the columns, you'll be asked to point them out — no file is ever a dead end.
import.pdfBody: For banks that only offer PDF. Read by AI on our server, so it leaves your device — we ask first. CSV is always more accurate where your bank offers it.
import.analysingHint: A full page of transactions can take up to a minute.

import.formatGuessedHint: We had to guess part of this. Check the dates and amounts below look right.
import.formatDetectedHint: Detected from your file. Change these if anything looks wrong.
